tasks.description: Zero-resource diagnostic of the current reused gated-horizon/latency-tree IMPROVED vehicle policies after all-shard validation showed s0/s1 constant-H25 collapse and s2 harmful H35 usage. The task reads existing training/search/selection and validation-output artifacts only, audits seed-level horizon-decision coverage, candidate/guard/profile provenance, and records what training/refit evidence is missing before any new nonzero controller-path run. It does not open validation64 generator/bank sources, run controllers/plant/solvers, train/refit, or access sealed/final tests.
